reason: term 'or his delegate' defined one way when reference is Secretary of Treasury (i), similarly construed for other officials (ii), so dispatch on which official is referenced.
(B) adds Guam/American Samoa officers as an alternative qualifying case on top of (A)'s general delegate meaning, so overall term is true if either applies.
ocaml:
type location =
  | Guam
  | American_samoa
  | Other_location

type tax_chapter =
  | Chapter_1
  | Chapter_2
  | Chapter_21
  | Other_chapter

let is_guam_or_american_samoa (loc : location) : bool =
  match loc with
  | Guam | American_samoa -> true
  | Other_location -> false

let is_covered_chapter (chapter : tax_chapter) : bool =
  match chapter with
  | Chapter_1 | Chapter_2 | Chapter_21 -> true
  | Other_chapter -> false

(* 7701(a)(12)(B) *)
let meaning_of_delegate_guam_or_american_samoa (loc : location) (chapter : tax_chapter) (o : officer) : bool =
  is_guam_or_american_samoa loc &&
  is_covered_chapter chapter &&
  (o.duly_authorized_directly || o.duly_authorized_by_redelegation)

let meaning_of_delegate_7701_a_12 (ref_official : official) (loc : location) (chapter : tax_chapter) (o : officer) : bool =
  meaning_of_delegate ref_official o ||
  meaning_of_delegate_guam_or_american_samoa loc chapter o
